name: cgc-styles
description: Quartz 5 engine that fixes the cgc family layer's place in the cascade: emits `@layer cgc;` and nothing else. See README.md, CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild compiles src/ to dist/, and the types are erased. Locally both resolve to the host Quartz's copies through quartz-v5/plugins/node_modules, so the package carries no lockfile and needs no install of its own.

quartz.name: cgc-styles
quartz.description: Fixes the cgc family layer's place in the cascade: above core and themes. Every cgc-* plugin that emits CSS depends on it.
